_file.note: Wording robustness. The usual pricing/packaging events (price up/down, plan added/removed/renamed, limits and allowances, annual discount), mostly from the competitors' own sources, written in wording a keyword list is unlikely to cover: numbers in words, slang, strikethrough, arrows, 'USD 20' and '€25 p/m', idioms like 'on the house' and 'lighter on the wallet'. Also includes negatives that contain trigger words ('no price change', 'Unchanged', '$200M', '$50 in credits', 'every account', 'never paid'), and four groups where the same change appears in different words and time formats (Z, +02:00, -04:00, -07:00, +01:00, fractional seconds). All signals fall inside 2026-W44 in Asia/Jerusalem. 'group' marks ids that must end up in one item; null means the id stands alone. Signal types are deliberately unreliable: several pricing changes arrive as type 'launch', and one type 'pricing' signal is not a change.
